name: deeptrace-workspace
description: DeepTrace: 1-to-1 WebRTC Video Calling with Controlled Deepfake Attack Simulation

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && node client/node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint server/src --deny-warnings
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix server
